text: The Ball must not weigh less than five ounces and a half, nor more than five ounces and three quarters.
text_norm: the ball must not weigh less than five ounces and a half, nor more than five ounces and three quarters.

text: At the beginning of each innings either party may call for a new ball.
text_norm: at the beginning of each innings either party may call for a new ball.

text: The Bat must not exceed four inches and one quarter in the widest part.
text_norm: the bat must not exceed four inches and one quarter in the widest part.

text: The Stumps must be twenty-seven inches out of the ground, the bails eight inches in length; the stumps of sufficient thickness to prevent the ball from passing through.
text_norm: the stumps must be twenty-seven inches out of the ground, the bails eight inches in length; the stumps of sufficient thickness to prevent the ball from passing through.

text: The Bowling-crease must be in a line with the stumps, six feet eight inches in length (the stumps in the centre), with the return-crease at each end, at right angles.
text_norm: the bowling-crease must be in a line with the stumps, six feet eight inches in length (the stumps in the centre), with the return-crease at each end, at right angles.

text: The Popping-crease must be four feet from the wicket, and parallel to it.
text_norm: the popping-crease must be four feet from the wicket, and parallel to it.

text: The Wickets must be pitched opposite to each other by the umpires at the distance of twenty-two yards.
text_norm: the wickets must be pitched opposite to each other by the umpires at the distance of twenty-two yards.

text: It shall not be lawful for either party during a match, without the consent of the other, to alter the ground, by rolling, watering, covering, mowing, or beating.
text_norm: it shall not be lawful for either party during a match, without the consent of the other, to alter the ground, by rolling, watering, covering, mowing, or beating.

text: This rule is not meant to prevent the striker from beating the ground with his bat near where he stands during the innings; nor to prevent the bowler from filling up holes, watering his ground, or using sawdust, &c., when the ground shall be wet.
text_norm: this rule is not meant to prevent the striker from beating the ground with his bat near where he stands during the innings; nor to prevent the bowler from filling up holes, watering his ground, or using sawdust, &c., when the ground shall be wet.

text: After rain the wickets may be changed with the consent of both parties.
text_norm: after rain the wickets may be changed with the consent of both parties.

text: The Bowler shall deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease; and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets, which he shall be permitted to do but once in the same innings. -2-
text_norm: the bowler shall deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease; and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets, which he shall be permitted to do but once in the same innings. -2-

text: The ball must be bowled (not thrown nor jerked), and delivered underhand with the hand below the elbow.
text_norm: the ball must be bowled (not thrown nor jerked), and delivered underhand with the hand below the elbow.

text: But if the ball be jerked or the arm extended from the body horizontally, and any part of the back of the hand be uppermost, or the hand horizontally extended when the ball shall be delivered, the umpire shall call "No Ball."
text_norm: but if the ball be jerked or the arm extended from the body horizontally, and any part of the back of the hand be uppermost, or the hand horizontally extended when the ball shall be delivered, the umpire shall call "no ball."

text: He may order the striker at his wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.
text_norm: he may order the striker at his wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.

text: If the bowler toss the ball over the striker’s head, or bowl it so wide that it shall be out of distance to be played at, the umpire (either with or without an appeal from the party receiving the innings) shall adjudge one run to the striker, even though he attempt to hit it - which shall be put down to the byes, and such ball shall not be reckoned as any of the four balls.
text_norm: if the bowler toss the ball over the striker's head, or bowl it so wide that it shall be out of distance to be played at, the umpire (either with or without an appeal from the party receiving the innings) shall adjudge one run to the striker, even though he attempt to hit it - which shall be put down to the byes, and such ball shall not be reckoned as any of the four balls.

text: If the bowler bowl a "no ball" the striker may play at it, and be allowed all the runs he can get, and shall not be put out, except by running out.
text_norm: if the bowler bowl a "no ball" the striker may play at it, and be allowed all the runs he can get, and shall not be put out, except by running out.

text: In the event of a change of bowling, no more than two balls shall be allowed in practice.
text_norm: in the event of a change of bowling, no more than two balls shall be allowed in practice.

text: The bowler who takes the two balls shall be obliged to bowl four balls.
text_norm: the bowler who takes the two balls shall be obliged to bowl four balls.

text: The Striker is out if the bail be bowled off, or the stump be bowled out of the ground.
text_norm: the striker is out if the bail be bowled off, or the stump be bowled out of the ground.

text: Or, if the ball, from a stroke over or under the bat, or upon his hands (but not wrists), be held before it touch the ground, although it be hugged to the body of the catcher.
text_norm: or, if the ball, from a stroke over or under the bat, or upon his hands (but not wrists), be held before it touch the ground, although it be hugged to the body of the catcher.

text: Or, if in striking, or at any other time while the ball is in play, both his feet be over the popping-crease, and his wicket is put down, except his bat be grounded within it.
text_norm: or, if in striking, or at any other time while the ball is in play, both his feet be over the popping-crease, and his wicket is put down, except his bat be grounded within it.

text: Or, if in striking at the ball, he hits down his wicket.
text_norm: or, if in striking at the ball, he hits down his wicket.

text: Or, if under pretence of running a notch, or otherwise, either of the strikers prevent a ball from being caught, the striker of the ball is out.
text_norm: or, if under pretence of running a notch, or otherwise, either of the strikers prevent a ball from being caught, the striker of the ball is out.

text: Or, if the ball be struck, and he wilfully strikes it again.
text_norm: or, if the ball be struck, and he wilfully strikes it again.

text: Or, if in running a notch, the wicket be struck down by a throw, or by the hand or arm (with ball in hand), before his foot, hand, or bat be grounded over the popping-crease; but if the bail be off, the stump must be struck out of the ground.
text_norm: or, if in running a notch, the wicket be struck down by a throw, or by the hand or arm (with ball in hand), before his foot, hand, or bat be grounded over the popping-crease; but if the bail be off, the stump must be struck out of the ground.

text: Or, if any part of the striker’s dress knock down the wicket.
text_norm: or, if any part of the striker's dress knock down the wicket.

text: Or, if the striker touch or take up the ball while in play, unless at the request of the other party.
text_norm: or, if the striker touch or take up the ball while in play, unless at the request of the other party.

text: Or, if with any part of his person he stops the ball, which in the opinion of the umpire at the bowler's wicket shall have been delivered in a straight line to the striker's wicket, and would have hit it.
text_norm: or, if with any part of his person he stops the ball, which in the opinion of the umpire at the bowler's wicket shall have been delivered in a straight line to the striker's wicket, and would have hit it.

text: If the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket which is put down is out.
text_norm: if the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket which is put down is out.

text: When a ball is caught, no notch shall be reckoned.
text_norm: when a ball is caught, no notch shall be reckoned.

text: When a striker is run out, the notch which they were running for is not to be reckoned.
text_norm: when a striker is run out, the notch which they were running for is not to be reckoned.

text: If a "Lost Ball" shall be called, the striker shall be allowed six; but if more than six shall have been run before "Lost Ball" shall have been called, then the striker shall have all which have been run.
text_norm: if a "lost ball" shall be called, the striker shall be allowed six; but if more than six shall have been run before "lost ball" shall have been called, then the striker shall have all which have been run.

text: When the ball has been in the bowler's or wicket-keeper’s hands, it is considered as no longer in play, and the strikers need not keep within their ground till the umpire has called "Play"; but if the player go out of his ground with an intent to run before the ball be delivered, the bowler may put him out.

text: If the striker be hurt, he may retire from his wicket and return to it at any time in that innings.
text_norm: if the striker be hurt, he may retire from his wicket and return to it at any time in that innings.

text: If a striker be hurt, some other person may be allowed to stand out for him, but not to go in.
text_norm: if a striker be hurt, some other person may be allowed to stand out for him, but not to go in.

text: No substitute in the field shall be allowed to bowl, keep wicket, stand at the point or middle-wicket, or stop behind to a fast bowler, unless with the consent of the adverse party.
text_norm: no substitute in the field shall be allowed to bowl, keep wicket, stand at the point or middle-wicket, or stop behind to a fast bowler, unless with the consent of the adverse party.

text: If any person stop the ball with his hat, the ball shall be considered as dead, and the opposite party shall add five notches to their score; if any be run, they are to have five in all.
text_norm: if any person stop the ball with his hat, the ball shall be considered as dead, and the opposite party shall add five notches to their score; if any be run, they are to have five in all.

text: If the ball be struck, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.
text_norm: if the ball be struck, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.

text: The Wicket-keeper shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the wicket, and shall not move till the ball be out of the bowler’s hand, and shall not by any noise incommode the striker; and if any part of his person be over or before the wicket, although the ball hit it, the striker shall not be out.

text: The Umpires are sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them, each at his own wicket; but in case of a catch, which the umpire at the wicket bowled from cannot see sufficiently to decide upon, he may apply to the other umpire, whose opinion is conclusive.
text_norm: the umpires are sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them, each at his own wicket; but in case of a catch, which the umpire at the wicket bowled from cannot see sufficiently to decide upon, he may apply to the other umpire, whose opinion is conclusive.

text: The umpires in all matches shall pitch fair wickets, and the parties shall toss for the choice of innings.
text_norm: the umpires in all matches shall pitch fair wickets, and the parties shall toss for the choice of innings.

text: They shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call "Play,” the party refusing to play shall lose the match.
text_norm: they shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call "play," the party refusing to play shall lose the match.

text: They are not to order a player out unless appealed to by their adversaries.
text_norm: they are not to order a player out unless appealed to by their adversaries.

text: But, if the bowler’s foot be not behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease, when he shall deliver the ball, they must, unasked, call "No Ball."
text_norm: but, if the bowler's foot be not behind the bowling-crease, and within the return-crease, when he shall deliver the ball, they must, unasked, call "no ball."

text: If the striker run a short notch, the umpire must call "No Notch."
text_norm: if the striker run a short notch, the umpire must call "no notch."

text: The umpires are not to be changed during the match but by the consent of both parties.
text_norm: the umpires are not to be changed during the match but by the consent of both parties.

text: LAW FOR SINGLE WICKET.
text_norm: law for single wicket.

text: When there shall be less than five players on a side, bounds shall be placed, twenty-two yards each, in a line from the off and leg stump.
text_norm: when there shall be less than five players on a side, bounds shall be placed, twenty-two yards each, in a line from the off and leg stump.

text: The ball must be hit before the bounds to entitle the striker to a run, which run cannot be obtained unless he touch the bowling stump with his bat, or some part of his person; returning to the popping-crease as at double wicket, according to the 22nd Law.
text_norm: the ball must be hit before the bounds to entitle the striker to a run, which run cannot be obtained unless he touch the bowling stump with his bat, or some part of his person; returning to the popping-crease as at double wicket, according to the 22nd law.

text: When the striker shall hit the ball, one of his feet must be on the ground, and behind the popping-crease; otherwise the umpire shall call "No Hit."
text_norm: when the striker shall hit the ball, one of his feet must be on the ground, and behind the popping-crease; otherwise the umpire shall call "no hit."

text: When there shall be less than five players on a side, no byes nor overthrows shall be allowed.
text_norm: when there shall be less than five players on a side, no byes nor overthrows shall be allowed.

text: The fieldsman -5must return the ball so that it shall cross the play between the wicket and the bowling stump, or between the wicket and the bounds.
text_norm: the fieldsman -5must return the ball so that it shall cross the play between the wicket and the bowling stump, or between the wicket and the bounds.

text: The striker may run till the ball shall be so returned.
text_norm: the striker may run till the ball shall be so returned.

text: After the striker shall have run one notch, if he start again he must touch the bowling stump, and turn before the ball shall cross the play to entitle him to another.
text_norm: after the striker shall have run one notch, if he start again he must touch the bowling stump, and turn before the ball shall cross the play to entitle him to another.

text: The striker shall be entitled to three notches for lost ball, and the same number for ball stopped with hat, with reference to the 29th and 44th Laws at double wicket.
text_norm: the striker shall be entitled to three notches for lost ball, and the same number for ball stopped with hat, with reference to the 29th and 44th laws at double wicket.

text: When there shall be more than four players on a side, there shall be no bounds.
text_norm: when there shall be more than four players on a side, there shall be no bounds.

text: All hits, byes, and overthrows shall then be allowed.
text_norm: all hits, byes, and overthrows shall then be allowed.

text: The bowler is subject to the same laws as at double wicket.
text_norm: the bowler is subject to the same laws as at double wicket.

text: Not more than one minute shall be allowed between each ball.
text_norm: not more than one minute shall be allowed between each ball.

text: BETS.
text_norm: bets.

text: If the notches of one player be laid against another, the bets depend on the first innings, unless otherwise specified.
text_norm: if the notches of one player be laid against another, the bets depend on the first innings, unless otherwise specified.

text: If the bets be made upon both innings, and one party beat the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.
text_norm: if the bets be made upon both innings, and one party beat the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.

text: But, if the other party go in a second time, then the bet must be determined by the number on the score.
